fixtures.note: THERE IS NO CANCEL EDGE: THE PANE COMMIT IS THE PENDING BYTE'S OWN CLEAR, AND A RE-COMMIT OF THE SPELL A HAND ALREADY HOLDS MOVES NEITHER POINTER. `recover_pair_mc2_kw` watched only the hand pointers and `array_0x437` for a select, so a player who re-commits the spell/tier that hand is already bound to moved nothing the recovery could see and the port never ran the handler - which means `SetSpell_6D5E0`'s UNCONDITIONAL re-price of the held manifestation never happened either. Proven corpus-wide rather than inferred: 1,008 `hand_pending -> 0` edges across 40 takes, and of the 40 that move nothing else ALL 40 carry a fresh select toast naming that hand's own spell - so every `hand_pending -> 0` in the corpus is a COMMIT and none is a cancel. WITNESS mc2l19 pair 5936->5937, the human's held (15,x) manifestation at slot 39: retail re-prices it to `mana_max` 5000 / `mana` 49 on the commit tick, the port left the previously bound tier standing at 1500 / 14. Those two fields are the pair's only dirty lanes. This head was first briefed as a MISSING castle re-price with two named `SetSpell_6D5E0` callers (`sub_6D8B0`'s XP grant and the unlabelled 0x529ad hand-bind); BOTH WERE REFUTED - the port never replayed the input at all. A/B: `MGC_NO_MC2_PENDING_COMMIT=1` re-reds this pair; the take's horizon goes 12,664 -> 4,893 and mc2l19-taketwo's 3,256 -> 461.

THE TRADER'S INVALID TARGET RETURNS - THE WANDER TURN AND THE FAR SCAN LIVE ON THE ZERO-TARGET ARM ONLY: `sub_237B0` tests `word_0x96_150` FIRST (NETHERW.EXE 0x480ee `mov 0x96(%ebx),%di` / `test %di,%di` / `jne 0x48221`), so the whole wander-turn + far-dwelling rescan body sits under the ZERO branch. A non-zero handle that fails validation clears the word, writes `actSpeed = maxSpeed` and jumps straight to LABEL_44 (0x48286-0x4829d): no LCG draws, no rescan, this tick. The port merged `target invalid` into `no target` and so spent two per-entity draws and re-acquired at `maxSpeed + 12`. WITNESS mc2l19 pair 4893->4894, the (5,x) trader at slot 447: retail `speed` 18 with `rand` 43,484, the port 30 with `rand` 32,250 - the speed row is the 18/30 MIRROR that showed on BOTH l19 takes, and the mirrored signature was the tell that this is a membership/branch question and not an arithmetic one. Those two fields are the pair's only dirty lanes. A/B: `MGC_NO_MC2_TRADER_INVALID_TARGET_RETURN=1` re-reds exactly this pair. Its sibling law `MGC_NO_MC2_TOWNIE_TARGET_REAP_BLIND` (the villager + trader rally handle validates on class 10 + model 45 and NOTHING else - neither brain reads the reap bit) measures zero in pair mode across all nine MC2 intake takes and takes a unit test instead.

AN ACTING (10,0) FIRE BETWEEN THE LAST BUILDING AND THE m27 BODY PUTS A POINTER BACK ON THE `v34` SLOT - AND IT IS THE *ACTING* ARM ONLY. `sub_29A90`'s `[ebp-0x10]` (`v34`) is stack residue left by whichever entity handler ran last before the m27 body, and the port modelled the (10,45) house, the (10,34) pad, the (11,x) switches and the 0xDA aim pass but had nothing for `sub_30D50`, the (10,0) fire. `sub_30D50` (NETHERW.EXE file 0x55550, prologue `53 56 57 55 89 e5 83 ec 04` => `ebp = W-20`, `esp = W-24` - ONE dword of locals, so every frame below it sits FOUR BYTES LOWER than the house's) has three exits: the fuse arm `if (dword_0x10_16 & 3) dword_0x10_16--;` (EF:22726) makes NO call at all; the reap arm `DisableEntityDrawing04_57F10(a1x)` (file 0x7C710, `55 89 e5 8b 45 08 80 48 0d 04 5d c3`) is a LEAF whose deepest write is W-36; and the ACTING arm ends on `sub_580E0(&position, alt, 0, 0, word_0x2C_44)` then `sub_585A0(a1x)`. `sub_585A0` (file 0x7CDA0, `53 55 89 e5`, `mov edx,[ebp+0xc]`, two byte compares, `ret`) calls nothing and bottoms out at W-40, so the last writer of W-64 is `sub_580E0` (file 0x7C8E0, `53 56 57 55 89 e5`): five args W-28..W-44, return W-48, `push ebx` W-52, `push esi` W-56, `push edi` W-60, `push ebp` W-64 - the caller's own frame pointer. W-52 takes its saved EBX, which `8b 5d 14` loaded with `a1x`. Both dwords are POSITIVE, EVEN and far above 4 - the seed's class - so a body walked after an acting fire keeps `f71 = 4` AND TAKES the wander draw, where the house's odd 29 makes it SKIP. *** A HANDLER'S OWN LOCAL-FRAME SIZE RE-HOMES WHICH REGISTER LANDS ON THE v34 SLOT ***: the fire's `sub esp,4` is the only difference from the house, and it is what puts `sub_580E0`'s saved EBP on W-64 where the house leaves ESI. WITNESS mc2l19 pair 12664->12665, the take's FIRST head: the m27 body at slot 127 sits behind the (10,45) house at slot 3 with the (10,0) smoke column at slots 1/2/4, and slot 4 is a live fire whose `act_life -= 1` lands on EXACTLY -1 - still the acting arm, since the reap test is `< -1`, which is why this pair and not the next one is the exemplar. Retail spends TWO LCG steps to the port's one: `heading` 537/917 and `rand` 18,721/64,258, the pair's only dirty lanes. Discriminated 20/20 across the take: 17 gate openings where slot 4 has already recycled to class 0 SKIP the draw in both arms, and the 3 where it is still an acting (10,0) take it - t=12,665, t=12,949 and t=13,388, exactly the take's three divergent boundaries. A/B: `MGC_NO_M27_V34_FIRE_RESIDUE=1` re-reds all three; with the law on, mc2l19 CERTIFIES (1 segment, 0 deviations, horizon END).

SPEED IS THE ONE MANIFESTATION WHOSE UNAFFORDABLE TICK DOES NOT COLLAPSE ITS BURST WINDOW - AND A DYING WIZARD IS UNAFFORDABLE, SO EVERY DEATH FALL FIRED THE ±minSpeed RESTORE. Twenty-five MC2 handlers close their effect body with a bare `else { word_0x2E_46 = 1 }` (EF:56236 / 56372 / 56700 / 56819 / 57041 / 57107 / 57388 / 57586 / 58049 …) and the port implements that as ONE SHARED ARM. `GetScroll_69DB0` (banner `//----- (00069DB0)`, the arm at EF:56567-70) is the EXCEPTION, and ⭐ it is the ONLY function in the image that reads `word_0xe_14` at all: its collapse is guarded on the BRAKE WORD ALONE, so an unaffordable tick skips the effect body and falls through to the plain `--word_0x2E_46`. `NETHERW.EXE` file 0x8E779 (VA 0x69F79), the join of the afford `je` at 0x8E61F and the brake `jne` at 0x8E630: `mov 0xa4(%esi),%eax` / `cmpw $0x0,0xe(%eax)` / `je 0x8e78c` (NO brake ⇒ NO collapse) / `movw $0x1,0x2e(%ebx)` (brake only) / then the shared `mov 0x2e(%ebx),%cx ; dec ; mov` and `jne 0x8e7cd` — zero ⇒ `imul 0x84(%esi),%di`, the ±80 restore. And the afford test `sub_68D50` (banner `//----- (00068D50)`, EF:55901-03; file 0x8D568 `cmpl $0x0,0x8(%edx)` / `jl`) bails on the CASTER's OWN VITALS - `mana < 0` then `life < 0` - so a wizard who has just been killed is unaffordable for every remaining tick of his death fall while his Speed window keeps counting down untouched. WITNESS mc2l19-taketwo pair 3256->3257: the player is flying BACKWARD under Speed (`cmd_speed`/`actSpeed` -240 at t=3243, -160 from t=3244), takes lethal damage at t=3256 (`life` -1200, `actionIndex` 0 -> 2) and touches down at t=3257. Retail's Speed token (slot 16, the `(15,3)`) records `word_0x2E_46` 287 -> 286 across the boundary - a plain decrement, no collapse - and the flight columns stay pinned at -160 through the landing and the whole dead wait (t=3258..3320 all -160). The port collapsed the counter to 1, decremented it to 0 in the same tick and mailed `pending_speed_base = -80`, so the corpse fell 79 units short. ⭐⭐ THE HEAD IS NOT POSE-ONLY, WHICH IS WHY THIS PAIR EARNS A FILE: `sub_5E310`'s touchdown places the `(10,40)` grave and scatters all 26 spell tokens from the carpet's MID-TICK position, so the whole class-15 band lands wrong too - this pair records `extra in port: slot 8 (10,1)` (the phantom slipstream puff) and slot 292 holding a DIFFERENT RECORD entirely (retail model 1 life 1, port model 2 life 31), i.e. the allocation rotated. ⚠ THE PUFF IS THE SECOND HALF OF THE SAME RETAIL `else` (EF:56602-10): an unaffordable tick spawns no `(10,2)` either, and WITHOUT that gate the law measures ZERO candidates - both halves are required. A/B: `MGC_NO_MC2_SPEED_BROKE_SURVIVES=1` re-reds this pair; the take goes 7 -> 6 segments, 5 -> 4 devs, and the free horizon 3,256 -> 12,905 (segment 1 now runs t=2,528..12,906 bit-exact, 10,377 boundaries). It also carried mc2l22-new 24 -> 23 and mc2l23 5 -> 4 for free.

THE HUMAN'S METEOR (SPELL 9) FIRE TICK LEAVES THE HAND-MUZZLE POSITION ON THE HYDRA'S W-64: in `sub_6AB00` (NETHERW.EXE file 0x8F300) the muzzle call `sub_68E50` (0x8D650) has its 6-byte position buffer `[ebp-8]` exactly on W-64, and everything called after it is shallower (MoveEntity reaches W-56; `sub_68DE0` is a leaf), so W-64 = muzzle.x | muzzle.y << 16. Idle human manifestations are otherwise transparent (all 26 class-15 handlers leave on `word_0x2E_46 <= 0` with no call and no frame store; `MGC_NO_MC2_M27_V34_TOKEN_TRANSPARENT`).
